headline: Orlen received an offer. Strategic installations are in play
summary: Gas Storage Poland, the storage operator owned by Gaz-System, submitted a non-binding offer to buy storage installations from Orlen. Strategic facilities are involved in the potential transaction.
why: PKN Orlen is Poland's largest refiner and fuel retailer, and Gaz-System operates the country's gas transmission network. Changes in gas storage ownership affect energy security and infrastructure investment.

impacts.name: Orlen
impacts.why: Orlen is the seller of the storage installations in the non-binding offer.
